segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation and describe the pads as gentle, though one reviewer who didn't consider her skin sensitive broke out in small red bumps that took over a week to clear.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the pads work well without stickiness, including one who calls them a good fit for her extremely oily skin.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers report their dark spots or acne scars visibly fading with continued use, but a similar number say they noticed good brightening of overall complexion with little to no change in their dark spots or blemish marks.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, and several say the pads reduced existing acne marks, though one reviewer broke out after use and gave someone else a reaction when she shared the pads.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe the pads as hydrating, helping with dryness, and some find them more moisturizing than other brands they'd tried.

aspects.libelle: Thick pads double as a mini sheet mask
Container prone to leaking or spilling
Refreshing when stored in the fridge
Good value, lasts a long time

extraits.texte: I didn't consider myself as having sensitive but it broke me out a lot…many small red bumps. It took over a week to clear:((. I even gave it a second chance. Also,I tried to give them to someone else but they had a reaction as well.

This is one of few skincare products I would confidently say has made a difference in my skin. My skin is more even, brighter, dark spots fade faster, and I haven't had any increased acne production since using these. My only problem is the lack of refill options available through Ulta. I have 6 "refillable" boxes just sitting around and it feels incredibly wasteful.

There's a generous amount of toner, enough to use with cotton pads even after finishing the included ones. It leaves the skin feeling deeply hydrated. The pads are a bit too thin, making them somewhat inconvenient to use for cleansing. It doesn't seem to effectively reduce blemishes.

extraits.titre: O M G... One of the best things I've tried!
extraits.texte: Coming from someone who hasn't changed their skincare routine in over a year. The very FIRST pad I used from this I could already tell a difference in my moisture. It has really been a game changer, as I've been searching for moisturizing products to help my dark spots & dryness subside. I am unsure of my skin type, but it gets dry extremely with no kind of moisturizer but would also get overly oily throughout the day to the point where it would itch and I would get cystic pimples, this product has not given me any irritation or itchiness at all! I will definitely be keeping this in my routine.

As someone with sensitive, blemish­prone skin, I've been using this as a doctor's office treatment and experienced no irritation. I loved the immediate brightening effect. My skin feels smoother, and the hydration is excellent! Even with my extremely oily skin, I didn't notice any stickiness. It's well­rounded and great for daily use. It has a distinct lemon scent, which I personally dislike as I'm not fond of sour fragrances. Other than that, no complaints! While it works well as a face pack, the pads are thicker than they appear in the photos. When used as a face pack, it kept falling off my face. It seems more suitable as a doctor's office treatment.

extraits.titre: After using it for about a...
extraits.texte: After using it for about a week, my skin texture has improved and feels moisturized. Above all, the pads are incredibly soft ­ I can't stress this enough! I highly recommend it. I bought it for its whitening claims, and while I'm not sure about actual lightening, my skin definitely looks more translucent and clearer. It was supposed to help with blemish removal, but I'm not really seeing much difference in that area, unfortunately. If you use this after Hwahae and top it off with the Mediheal serum, it's absolutely perfect for hydration.
